caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with a high, curved backrest featuring an elongated central splat with carved detailing. The wood is rendered in shades of brown, with darker and lighter tones used to illustrate grain and depth. The seat of the chair is upholstered in a patterned fabric colored in shades of red and purple with floral or vine-like designs. The chair’s legs are curved, with the front legs terminating in small pad feet and the back legs having simple outward angles. There are cross-braces connecting the legs on each side and an additional decorative stretcher between the side braces near the floor. The background is plain, off-white, with a faint rectangular border framing the entire composition.
title: Side Chair
